name: Documentation sweep: everything documented
body: Dean (2026-11-16): make sure everything is documented. Audit docs/ against the code on nox-proto and fix what is stale: the root README still describes the Rust engine, architecture.md is the Rust tour, game-api.md and renderer.md predate the renderer effects. Deliver a docs index, a Nyx API reference, tutorials, a run guide, a quality guide and a known-gaps list. Docs and comment-only edits, in small PRs split by area. Lantern is a tutorial repo: lantern::: names, no other engine named.
